mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a baseline model (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month FEDFUNDS rate crossing above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and reducing equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in FEDFUNDS rates and downward movement in UNRATE (unemployment) signals conflicting pressures: higher rates reducing growth potential while labor market tightness may constrain demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite both FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% suggests robust demand without overheating, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline in late-cycle periods with CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the INDPRO index reflects healthy supply-side growth, reducing production costs and boosting corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns underperform a supply-trend model during periods of sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing below 4% indicates improving labor market conditions, reducing wage growth pressures and attracting investment to equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-positive despite UNRATE dropping below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% and UNRATE falls below 4%, it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting a tight labor market, fostering equity valuation growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative policy and strong labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise when both FEDFUNDS <2% and UNRATE <4% occur simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous FEDFUNDS rate increases and UNRATE declines signal policy normalization and labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline during post-shock periods with FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling.
